job: Publish one approved Git boundary from exact mission-owned source heads with non-force, fast-forward-only semantics, and stop with a typed failure rather than reaching for a bypass.

refs.purpose: A publish never resolves its own checkout.
The checkout and mutation branch being published.
pre-commit and pre-push, which always run.
The publication target and its observed head.
Where the publication receipt is written.

sideEffects: push already approved mission-owned heads to the declared remote ref without force
push one annotated continuation tag pointing at a head this publication pushed
write only the typed publication receipt under input.artifactRootRef
forbiddenSideEffects: force push, lease-force push, or rewrite published history
delete a branch, local or remote
bypass, skip, or disable a Git hook
amend, rebase, or squash a commit in order to make a rejected push succeed
create or switch to a task, feature, or worktree branch under a forbidden worktree policy
publish a head outside the approved boundary or its declared write roots
publish without a verified route or an approval bound to this exact boundary
stopConditions: the route receipt is missing, blocked, or bound to another project and role
no approval covers this exact boundary unit
the active branch violates the routed Git mutation policy
the working tree is dirty outside the declared boundary
a Git hook blocks the publication
the remote rejects the push as non-fast-forward
the observed source head differs from the frozen head
a resume adds no effective head, approval, hook, or remote delta
